name: Water Level, Floodplain & Shoreline Transformation Runtime
design_rules: water level responds to flood and drought events rather than changing arbitrarily
shoreline expands and contracts according to local shore slope
floodplain classes activate progressively as water rises
higher water can deepen traversal zones and connect shallow channels
lower water can expose banks and disconnect marginal channels
North Woodland retains inundation longer than Ring Basin
shoreline transformation changes habitat availability without creating population directly
water-level transformation never uses emissive or glow feedback
